body:
Adds `research/lag-twin`: a twin with an instantaneous actuator is stable at any PD gain, while the real loop with first-order lag τ is stable iff τ < kd/kp = 2ζ/ωn (Routh, matches roots in 168/168 cases), hunts at the twin's own ωn, and cannot decay faster than 1/(3τ) for any gains. Includes tests (8), experiments with results.txt, white paper, README bullet and site entry. `python site/build.py` prints ok.

Stylised: linear, one lag, noiseless, simulated "real" plant.
